meta.title: 15 Things to Know BEFORE Visiting VIETNAM!
meta.description:
Vietnam is a country that surprises you at every turn — from the chaotic charm of Hanoi’s Old Quarter to the peaceful lantern‑lit nights of Hoi An, and the dramatic limestone cliffs of Cat Ba and Ha Long Bay.In this video, we share 15 essential things you need to know before visiting Vietnam, based on nearly three months of real travel experience across cities, small towns, and nature escapes.

You’ll learn:How to navigate Vietnam using Grab, trains, and sleeper buses.  Why cash and digital payments both matter.

The best times to visit and what to expect from Vietnam’s tropical weather.  How to experience the local culture — from street food stalls and coffee shops.  Insider tips for budget travel, language basics, and avoiding tourist traps. 

We’ll take you through our journey from Hanoi to Da Nang, stopping at Cat Ba, Hoi An, and other unforgettable spots — showing you what to pack, what to expect, and how to make the most of your time in Vietnam.  Whether you’re planning a short holiday or a long adventure, this guide will help you arrive prepared and travel confidently through one of Southeast Asia’s most captivating destinations.
